verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence pack documents simultaneous multi-user editing of the same file, live cursors, or instant sync. The pricing line 'Unlimited Teams - Collaborate freely' is about how many teams you can have, not real-time co-editing, so it is an adjacent feature. Community comments about several self-hosted users say nothing about live multiplayer editing.

support.subject: As a designer, my whole team can edit the same file simultaneously with live cursors and instant sync
